description: This file defines the UsersAndGroupsSearchProvider class, which provides search functionality for users and groups within the ownCloud Android client. It interacts with the ShareRepository to retrieve matching sharees, processes various share types (users, groups, federated, email, room, circle), and constructs Cursor responses for search suggestions.

classes.name: UsersAndGroupsSearchProvider
classes.description: Provides search capability for users and groups, constructing cursors for search suggestions based on repository data and various share types.

methods.name: UsersAndGroupsSearchProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializes the provider with context and repository, and sets up URI matching.

methods.name: searchForUsersOrGroups
methods.description: Performs search for users or groups matching the query, returning a Cursor with suggestions.
